selection: First three chronological intervals in 220–400 s, between adjacent PASS events of the same team whose receiver then passes; duration 1–6 s. Selected from events before importing positions; no replacement after exclusion.

protocol.missingPolicy: Exclude whole interval on missing, inconsistent or unsynchronized samples; no filling and no replacement
protocol.possession: Inferred from adjacent pass reception and subsequent pass by same actor, checked against ball distance at every original sample; not direct observation of continuous control
protocol.simulation: Observed holder, ball, rivals and keepers imposed; other attacking players simulated; roles approximated from stable jersey order
protocol.primary: Time-weighted mean positional error in metres, paired 0.34 and 0.35
secondary: backward distance per player per second
protocol.decision: No generalization claim from three short intervals of a previously used match. If rule never activates, report uninformative for its effect. Any worse interval is a regression. No coefficient adjustment. Tactical utility requires later annotated review.
